headline: Executive order creates a council of federal agencies to work on the One Trillion Trees effort.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new group called the One Trillion Trees Interagency Council. The council brings together several federal agencies to coordinate work related to the One Trillion Trees effort, which is about planting, growing, and protecting trees. No title or summary details were provided on the council's exact duties, members, or funding.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies named in the order would take part in the new council and coordinate their tree-related work through it.

when_it_takes_effect: 2020-10-13, the date it was signed (executive orders usually take effect when signed)
